summary: Venture Global filed an 8-K covering a Power Frame Agreement dated October 9, 2026 between subsidiary Venture Global LNG and GE Vernova Operations plus Baker Hughes Energy Services for up to 16 power islands with deliveries through 2034. A separate reservation agreement covers eight of the remaining fifteen islands, with the first purchase order expected by end-2026 and further orders beginning early 2027. If all purchase orders and the Grid Frame Agreement are elected, aggregate payable would be roughly $17.2 billion. This is an ordinary commercial supply contract, not a special situation; watch reservation deadlines from October 2027 to October 2029 and capex pacing.
